'''Herbie''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

==Character history==
Herbie is, in [[1992]], the astral goat of [[The Truth]] who claims that he travels around on Herbie and that he has not driven in [[1977|fifteen years]], despite owning a [[Camper]], which he calls the Mothership.
